text_block_list.text:
The pre-summer injury had completely healed.
There were no hindrances whatsoever to coaching Espoir City.

However, I won't change my coaching approach from summer.
I'll take a step back and focus on supporting her.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew...
Trainer, show me the recorded footage!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that curve in the middle leg, right?
Yeah, it's that curve in the middle section, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, right there!
Next time, I'm cutting in even closer to the inside!

Even without me telling her,
she already possesses the judgment
needed to make improvements herself.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (...None of the training we did together was in vain.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I'll use all of it as reference.
So I can decisively win my race.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Every single order and strategy you've taught me—I won't let a single one slip away!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...The day after tomorrow is finally the big day, huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...My old man?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...
...Do you really have time to be making calls like that, you bastard?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Because it was necessary."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: "...My ba—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare apologize!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't apologize.
I didn't call you for that."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't go callin' what happened a "waste."
Everything up till now... made me who I am.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
............You're right."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...So, regarding next time..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Bring Mom along to watch my race next time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'll show you, too. What Espoir City is made of.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...See ya.
The day of the Champions Cup.

Checking the track conditions in place of Espoir City, who was
focusing in the waiting room...
—I received a message and headed over to the reserved seats.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Thanks as always for taking such good care of me!
...And from my dad too!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Espo invited me directly,
telling us to come watch together. ...And so,

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
What kind of upbringing did you
give her—that girl?
Education—it exists to hone the ability to make one's own choices.

To make a choice, one needs their own criteria.
And to build those criteria, knowledge is essential.
"She learned perspectives other than her own, comparing others' standards with her own and turning it into knowledge."
—And with that, she determined her own path.

I decided to become someone who can protect
what matters most to me.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: And "my role as her educator" is—

text_block_list.text:
Standing before Espoir City's parents,
I take a deep breath... and tell them.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...They've departed, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
We're so lucky that person
is Espo's Trainer...
aren't we, Dad?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're late, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Geez,
and we're supposed to enter the paddock soon, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So, could you see it from the stands?
The dirt condition... How did it look?
choice_data_list: Well, if it's you, you'll be fine!
Well, you'll be just fine, I'm sure!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Rough?!
Isn't that way too rough?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Whether the track's fast or heavy,
I'm still gonna be the one who wins.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho,
I can hardly let a statement like that slide~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Accu-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Tran-san.
Espo-san. How about you, Munchy-san?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Lookin' pretty confident, aren't ya?! You bastard?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, me, having room to spare...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Without the composure to calmly assess the race,
I wouldn't stand a chance against you, would I?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Espon,
we're super motivated too, ya know~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The battle between you and Accu-san in last year's Champions Cup...
...gave me such a huge thrill."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: And so, having just stood by and watched, I was filled with suuuuper deep regret, which brings us to where I am today. The end!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So... thrill me, okay?
Espon.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose either~!
Fuhoo!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha...
You got some nerve, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
'Cause I'm super strong!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna leave every single one of 'em in the dust and take the win!

And so, Espoir City
stepped into the paddock.

Seeing her dependable figure,
the last page of the notebook is filled.
I should trust how much she's grown—and see her off.
